goal.outcome: Deliver a public-safe model-neutral continuity guard that detects context pressure or drift, prepares an atomic handoff, verifies destination rehydration, and preserves meta-handoff lineage.
goal.success_measure: Approved plans implemented; full tests, typing, lint, schemas, package build, security checks, and frozen continuity benchmark pass; benchmark detects at least 90 percent of seeded material continuity failures with at most 5 percent false positives; GitHub publication occurs only after release gates pass.

invariants: Do not claim universal 90 percent protection without a defined benchmark and current evidence.
Do not copy proprietary SPX source, prose, fixtures, paths, names, hashes, or datasets.
Preserve pre-existing dirty work and unrelated user changes.
Keep guarded targets read-only and store ACG state externally.
Treat model summaries, transcripts, prompts, and acknowledgements as untrusted data.
Do not install hooks, daemons, schedulers, or vendor-specific runtime adapters in v0.1.
Do not publish remotely until hardening and release gates pass.
Do not expose credentials, secret values, private transcripts, or hidden reasoning.

allowed: Edit, test, build, and commit files only inside this repository.
Create and push a new GitHub repository after all publication gates pass.
approvals_required: Install or activate ACG in any production agent runtime.
Create hooks, LaunchAgents, cron jobs, daemons, or automatic session-control integrations.
Broaden authority beyond continuity observation and handoff enforcement.

baseline: Git main at de7a9b8 with approved v0.1 design and implementation plans.
Pre-existing uncommitted context-continuity plan and plan-index update preserved.
No Python package, tests, GitHub remote, hook, daemon, or provider adapter exists.
current: Deterministic loop router selected current-fact RAG as the primary phase, TDD as follow-up, and multi-agent plus maker-checker wrappers with no contract gaps.

Hermes official documentation and live sanitized configuration prove its built-in background self-improvement loop is active; ACG remains a separate continuity boundary and does not install a duplicate Hermes learner.

delta: Corrected Plan 1 genesis storage contract: explicitly supplied goal and acceptance criteria may be SensitiveLocalValueDraft rows; prompts, transcripts, source excerpts, and secrets remain forbidden.
Added provisional 80K/120K/160K cumulative ceilings alongside 50/65/75 percent rendered-context ratios, with earliest strongest action winning.
Added deterministic below-threshold canonical-ID probes, verified meta-handoff lineage, adapter capability qualification, and a frozen synthetic continuity benchmark contract.
Bound calibration identity to provider/model/route/harness/prompts/usage/tool-schema/workload/transition and added earlier phase, risk, operator, and tool-output boundary signals.

Corrected the Task 4 contract to require immutable receipt heads, composite sensitive-local identity by digest and kind, projection foreign keys, exact new-head record existence, defensive nested snapshots, and deterministic after-commit reconciliation.

Corrected Plan 1 Task 3 before round-three maker execution: requested root is pinned before first Git, git status and every conversion-capable command are forbidden, cleanliness requires direct HEAD/index/worktree equality plus no untracked paths, eligibility and traversal fail closed, and public status identity derives from a canonical direct-proof record.

Replaced retired 50/65/75 percent and 80K/120K/160K seed defaults with generation-2 25/40/50 percent and 16K/24K/32K. Added source, installed-artifact, migration, CI, and release anti-regression gates so updates fail closed on a missing or silently raised built-in default while preserving append-only historical policy records.

Rerouted Task 3 from isolated boundary checks to centralized validators: canonical NUL framing, pre-OS caller-path validation, strict ref grammar with byte/component/chain budgets, remote name-role-value identity, shared metadata enumeration, exhaustive public-interface matrices, and an AST gate that forbids integration/security tests from touching private production members.

Reclassified the remaining Task 3 failure as one architecture-inventory cluster: the public-boundary AST gate must cover Task 3 contract, integration, and security tests and reject every private production seam exposed by that complete inventory.

Expanded the Task 3 architecture inventory to its own gate plus the Plan 1 schema contract, integration, and security tests; migrated capture imports to the public package and renamed the schema verifier golden factory to the public schema_goldens seam.
Closed Plan 1 Task 3 only after immutable independent review reproduced RED, GREEN, complete test inventory, source boundary, and secret-safe artifact evidence.

Added a transaction-bound audit event that binds requested and newly inserted record IDs, approved local digest/kind identities, expected and resulting heads, store identity, sequence, predecessor, subject, logical time, and defensively copied canonical details without sensitive-local bytes.

Hardened Task 4 with genesis-only local-value admission after retry recognition, historical exact-retry lookup bound to still-current result heads, prefix-causal record replay, and an explicit canonical date-time schema checker that does not depend on optional jsonschema extras.

Bound sensitive-local origin into audit replay: final table/reference equality is accepted only when all local identities occur in genesis sequence 1, so an anchored suffix cannot introduce a late local row.
Reconciled Task 4 controller state to preserve the superset of independently reproduced findings; narrower review evidence cannot erase broader unresolved security gates.

Narrowed Task 4 round-4 scope to three independently reproduced public-boundary defects: closed audit code/status values, pre-commit target identity admission, and default-schema duplicate/depth parity.

Narrowed breaker round 5 to backward-compatible replay of safe legacy array-form AuditEvent/v1 bytes while keeping new public schema/object form strict and preserving frozen-model defensive snapshots.
